part.text: All dependent tests pass. Final review of the change:

Fixed. The bug was in `DocsClientRuntime.getActiveVersion` (packages/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/src/client/docsClientUtils.ts:283): version matching relied on `getLatestVersion` returning the version with `isLast` and matched it last, which both crashed when no version had `isLast` and mis-detected the active version when the current version's path was `/` (or the plugin base like `/docs`), freezing the `docsVersionDropdown` label on "Current".

The fix orders versions by path specificity (most path segments first, stable sort) and picks the first one whose route matches the current pathname, so:
- a root/base-path `current` version no longer swallows more specific version paths
- matching is insensitive to version order and to `isLast`
- trailing slashes and docs-only root paths (`/`) are handled via `matchPath` (`strict: false`)
- no crash when no version has `isLast`
